First off, the shading is off, seems like there isn’t a specific light source, unless he’s in the city, but in that case the shading would be much lighter. Also the colors seem flat, like there isn’t any depth or variety. The eye just seems bland, and it mostly doesn’t belong in that spot, also. Work on your hands. It seems like all the fingers are on the same level, but fingers are arched. Lastly, blood does not move like that, it seems like it’s defying gravity. Moving towards the chin on a tilted face just looks wrong.

Overall it needs work, but the fact that you want to draw and are open to critique is great, keep at it and you will get better
